name: agent-push-consent-decisions
body: Agent push/tag consent decisions [with user]. (1) Rule relaxed from "agents must never push or tag" to "agents must never push or tag without explicit, per-action consent". Consent is explicit and per-action — never standing or blanket. Absent that consent, agents never push or tag. With explicit per-action consent for the specific action, an agent may perform any push/tag operation the human asked for, including force-push and moving/overwriting/deleting a tag; no push/tag operation remains categorically barred once that specific action is explicitly authorised. (2) Naming caveat: the constraint's FQN is global.constraint.humans-push-and-tag, but node names (FQNs) are immutable, so it was NOT renamed; the name is now a slight misnomer — the law it carries is "push/tag require explicit per-action human consent", not "only humans push/tag". (3) CI carve-out retained: the CI release workflow may push manifest-only commits (version/URL/checksum updates confined to `Formula/` and `bucket/`), and automation may only react to a consented tag (a tag created by a human, or by an agent acting under explicit per-action consent); the release workflow itself never pushes code and never creates tags. (4) Reconciliations: the current-truth nodes asserting the old rule were amended — global.constraint.humans-push-and-tag, solution.component.release-workflow, solution.note.distribution-solution, requirements.stakeholder.kalide-maintainers, requirements.requirement.package-manifest-update, domain.service.publish-release, domain.entity.release, domain.value.version, solution.component.changelog. Historical notes: requirements.note.distribution-decisions is annotated SUPERSEDED in part, and requirements.note.fix-ci-manifest-push keeps its source quote verbatim with an appended SUPERSEDED marker (existing convention). requirements.note.release-0-5-0-decisions is left verbatim as a historical v0.5.0 decision record (same treatment the earlier CI-carve-out change gave it). (5) Code follow-ups for the plan (not spec nodes): update the comments in `.github/workflows/release.yml` ("Trigger: ONLY a human-pushed version tag") and `.github/workflows/native-e2e.yml` ("a human-pushed vX.Y.Z tag"), the INSTALL.md push/tag paragraph, and regenerate the agent definitions that carry "Never push or tag — humans only" (`.opencode/agents/implementer.md`, web-implementer.md, content-implementer.md, release-implementer.md, test-implementer.md, e2e-test-implementer.md, implementation-phase-reviewer.md). [with user]
